submitter: bugs_open/333 lane — closing the door's residual (owner rulings 2026-08-25): seam-route the last raw-INSERT content-finding producer, and stop the ownership false alarm at its source
rationale: The owned-page door (WII-028, APPROVED corr 9813dec8, live 2026-08-24 19:19Z) parks findings at the shared writeWorkItem seam. Its measured residual since going live is exactly two producer classes, and the owner ruled on both on 2026-08-25 after an adversarial re-review. (1) write_audit_findings_action.go:987 is a raw `INSERT INTO site_work_items` that bypasses the seam: three offer-analysis content_rewrite findings on owned pages died wont_fix at 2026-08-24 22:08:39Z, three hours after the door went live. The promoter-side alternative was REJECTED on evidence: the promoter of record for those rows is the scheduled task `detected-item-promoter`'s raw-SQL pre_query (all three carry the identical triaged_at 22:21:38.324 of one 900s tick), not the Go TriageDetectedItemsAction (live but infrequent — improvement-loop had no run on that site in the window), so a workItemRoutableSQL predicate would not have covered them, and a SQL-side park would re-implement ownedPageParkedItem's shape in a second medium — the 'one contract in two media' drift work_items_common.go already documents. The fix routes the action's write through writeWorkItem itself. Named behaviour changes beyond the door: the anti-churn brake now applies to audit findings (within-window repeat -> deferred with retry_after; >=2 terminal siblings in 7 days -> born unresolved), and the seam's ON CONFLICT backstops the action's own EXISTS pre-check. The registration probe does NOT newly apply — rows are born 'detected', which workItemStatusRequiresRegisteredHandler excludes; they still meet that probe at promotion, unchanged. Each finding gets its own transaction so the action's log-and-continue-per-finding contract survives (a failed statement poisons a Postgres tx). (2) escalateRerenderToWriter (rerender_page_sections_action.go) resolves a pageID at :196-215, then omits it from the needs_page item it mints at :1415 and births it 'triaged' — so its 13 owned-page escalations in the door's first 14h passed THROUGH the seam invisibly (no page_id => door stands down) and were refused wont_fix. An owned page's widget slots legitimately hold no content_data — that is what 'owned' means — so this escalation is a structural false alarm on owned pages (12 of the 13 parents were assemble-mode runs that COMPLETED). Owner chose remedy (i): check rebuild_policy before escalating, at source, rather than pass-the-id-and-park (the shared needs_page:<name> key slot would then be held by a non-terminal row against reconcile_site_plan's use of the same namespace) and rather than name-resolution at the door (a hot-shared-path widening the round-1 guardian objection argues against). The guard reuses pageIsOwnedForGuard — owned_page_guard.go's stated single sanctioned reader — and saveSectionsLookupPageID, fails open on every lookup problem, and lives inside the helper because 'a precondition parked in a caller is one port away from gone' (that file's own lesson). All four guards are mutation-proven: neutered guard, raised-on-skip, fail-closed rewrite, and recurrenceExpected sneaking onto audit findings each fail a named test.

plan.risks: (1) anti-churn brake now applies to audit findings: a finding whose key saw 2 terminal siblings in 7 days is born unresolved instead of detected. Accepted deliberately — that is the seam's contract for every detector producer, and the door runs BEFORE the brake so owned-page rows park first (WII-028's ordering argument). (2) per-finding transactions add BeginTx/Commit per row where there was one bare Exec; audit batches are tens of findings, not thousands — cost accepted for the log-and-continue contract. (3) the escalation guard adds 2 reads (PK-shaped) per escalation attempt; escalations are rare (13 in 14h fleet-wide was an anomaly). (4) 8 raw-INSERT writers remain (admin handlers and non-content producers); the handler's own refusal (301) stays their backstop, unchanged, and none has been measured firing on owned pages since the door went live.
